Niroshan Dickwella leads the charge with an unbeaten 59 off 37 balls as Lumbini Lions chase down 106 to defeat Sudurpaschim Royals by 6 wickets and book their place in the NPL final!
Dipendra Singh Airee's fighting 52 went in vain as Lumbini's bowlers, led by Sher Malla and Ruben Trumpelmann, restricted the Royals to 105/8.
